summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corp filed an 8-K solely to report the issuance of 3,283,844 shares of Class A common stock in satisfaction of earn-out obligations under a 2021 Business Combination Agreement. The issuance includes 3,277,438 shares for Triggering Event II and 6,406 shares for tax withholding. As of filing, 6,561,282 total shares have been issued under the agreement, and all required issuances from Triggering Events I & II are complete. Up to 10,000,000 additional shares remain contingent on stock price targets through October 19, 2026. No price, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. The filing describes no active special situation—it is a routine contractual fulfillment.
